one_sentence: This document catalogs formal bidirectional mappings between physics, theology, and mathematics as the core of the Isomorphism Explorer series.
executive_summary: The document serves as an index for the Isomorphism Explorer series, listing over 30 isomorphism records that map concepts between physics, theology, and mathematics. Each entry is described as bidirectional, falsifiable, and grounded in both domains. The index provides links to individual isomorphism records, each with a unique ISO number, title, date, and status (e.g., Testing, Candidate). This collection forms the structural backbone of the Theophysics Research Initiative, enabling cross-domain analysis and formal comparison.
short_summary: This document is an index of isomorphism records for the Isomorphism Explorer series. It lists over 30 formal mappings between physics, theology, and mathematics, each bidirectional and falsifiable. The index provides links to individual records with status indicators. It matters because it organizes the core structural claims of the Theophysics Research Initiative.
